zstandard: *** Zstandard CLI (64-bit) v1.5.7, by Yann Collet ***

parameters.Zstandard: CLI level 3, default frame, if installed

timing: Median file-to-file wall time; no fsync; warm cache; validation outside timing. All individual samples retained. No warmup. Fixed codec order.
provenance: Original synthetic corpus plus pinned, licensed public media and non-aligned repetition controls. Source/licensing details per item. No application or APK inputs; benchmark itself is offline.

corpus.name: text.txt
corpus.provenance: Original synthetic UTF-8 English/Arabic records, 9000 numbered rows.

corpus.name: repeated.bin
corpus.provenance: Four aligned copies of SHAKE-256(label=digital-fold-repeat-v1), each 1 MiB.

corpus.name: short-repeat.bin
corpus.provenance: Eight-byte literal ABCD0123 repeated 131072 times; ordinary compression control.

corpus.name: noise.png
corpus.provenance: Synthetic 512x512 RGB noise PNG, filter 0, zlib level 9, SHAKE-256 label digital-fold-png-v1.

corpus.name: shifted-repeat.bin
corpus.provenance: 17-byte SHAKE-256 prefix + four original 1 MiB blocks. Fixed shift is NOT a complete deduplication defeat: three interior shifted chunks still match (two references).

control.generator: SHAKE-256; exact labels and lengths in public_benchmark.py

corpus.name: nonaligned-period.bin
